timing_definitions.preprocess_ms: Primary candidate route-row load plus candidate generation; excludes fixture construction.
timing_definitions.model_build_ms: Primary model build portion excluding primary preprocessing and aggregate stage A wall solve time.
timing_definitions.solve_ms: Aggregate stage A wall time plus main CP-SAT solver wall time; diagnostic solve work is separately reported.
timing_definitions.schedule_ms: Primary generate_provider_schedule wall time excluding nested minimum-budget/capacity diagnostic calls.
timing_definitions.route_ms: Time spent reconstructing/optimizing output routes in the primary schedule call.
timing_definitions.diagnostics_ms: Nested minimum-budget and capacity diagnostic calls.
timing_definitions.total_ms: Primary plan generation including nested diagnostics plus invariant validation; fixture construction excluded.

baseline_findings.primary_observation: At 50 areas, the 3-stage primary schedule took about 3.74 s while the nested minimum-budget diagnostic took about 4.3 s; route reconstruction and invariant validation were milliseconds.
known_v5_gaps: model build and preprocessing were previously conflated in the solver profile
baseline_findings.quality_warning: All recorded invariant checks passed; minimum coverage was unmet in most scale cases. A skipped >500k-arc monolithic case is NOT_RUN, not an invariant pass or failure.
